chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام ruled concerning one who required a man from the People of the Book to swear a solemn oath: that he should make him swear by his scripture and his religion.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام as Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ: the People of the Book, such as Jews and Christians

ai.seo_question: How should a man from the People of the Book be made to swear an oath in Islamic legal proceedings?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام regarding administering an oath to a man from the People of the Book. It indicates that such an oath is to be taken in accordance with his own scripture and religious confession.
